description: Lee-Sun-Cendes FEM (Whitney edges + P1 nodes) of a 10.0 x 10.0 mm PEC waveguide, air-filled, at 50.0 GHz: A x = lambda B x with lambda = -beta^2 [mm^-2]; A and B indefinite (B: 64 negative / 225 positive), 64-fold zero eigenvalue (null space of A, non-physical), 18 propagating modes in the continuous model.

targets.why: all propagating modes (lambda = -beta^2 < 0); sigma lies mid-way between two spectral gaps that the dense discrete spectrum cannot close, so the k nearest eigenvalues are exactly this group; the zero cluster (lambda = 0) is excluded.

the least evanescent modes just above the zero cluster (lambda > 0, close to cutoff); sigma lies mid-way between two spectral gaps that the dense discrete spectrum cannot close, so the k nearest eigenvalues are exactly this group.

citation: J.-F. Lee, D.-K. Sun, Z. J. Cendes, Full-wave analysis of dielectric waveguides using tangential vector finite elements, IEEE Trans. MTT 39(8):1262-1271, 1991
name: waveguide-50ghz
